sections.description: Dishonestly taking any movable property out of the possession of any person without consent.
ingredients: Movable property involved
Taken out of possession of another person
Taken without that person's consent
Dishonest intention to take the property (Mens Rea)
sections.compoundable: Compoundable by owner with permission of court
sections.max_punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both

sections.offence_title: Theft in dwelling house, place of worship, or transport
sections.offence_title_hi: घर, पूजा स्थल या वाहन में चोरी
sections.description: Commits theft in any building, tent or vessel used as a human dwelling or for custody of property.
ingredients: All ingredients of theft (dishonest taking of movable property without consent)
Committed inside a building, tent, vessel, or place used for human dwelling or custody of property
sections.max_punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

sections.description: Intentionally putting any person in fear of any injury and dishonestly inducing them to deliver property.
ingredients: Intentionally putting any person in fear of injury to that person or another
Dishonestly inducing that person so put in fear to deliver any property or valuable security
sections.max_punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both

sections.description: Theft or extortion accomplished by causing or attempting to cause death, hurt, or wrongful restraint, or fear of instant hurt/death.
ingredients: Theft or extortion is committed
Offender for that end voluntarily causes or attempts to cause death, hurt, or wrongful restraint, OR fear of instant death, instant hurt, or instant wrongful restraint
sections.max_punishment: Rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years (or 14 years if on highway between sunset and sunrise)

sections.description: When five or more persons conjointly commit or attempt to commit a robbery.
ingredients: Commission or attempt to commit robbery
Conjointly committed by five or more persons (acting together)
sections.max_punishment: Imprisonment for life, or rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine

sections.offence_title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
sections.offence_title_hi: धोखाधड़ी / छल और संपत्ति सौंपने के लिए बेईमानी से प्रेरित करना
sections.description: Cheats and thereby dishonestly induces the person deceived to deliver any property.
ingredients: Deception of any person by fraudulent or dishonest representation
Inducing that person to deliver property or alter/destroy valuable security
Dishonest intention from the inception of the transaction
sections.compoundable: Compoundable by person cheated with court permission
sections.max_punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

sections.description: Dishonestly misappropriating or converting to own use property entrusted to the offender.
ingredients: Entrustment of property or dominion over property
Dishonest misappropriation, conversion, or dishonest use/disposal in violation of legal direction/contract
sections.max_punishment: Imprisonment up to 5 years, or fine, or both

sections.description: Voluntarily doing an act causing bodily pain, disease, or infirmity to any person.
ingredients: Bodily pain, disease or infirmity caused to a person
Act was done intentionally or with knowledge that it is likely to cause hurt
Absence of grave and sudden provocation
sections.compoundable: Yes, by the person to whom hurt is caused
sections.max_punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine up to ₹10,000, or both

sections.description: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt such as fracture, permanent privation of sight/hearing, or severe bodily pain for 15+ days.
ingredients: Hurt caused falls into categories of grievous hurt (emasculation, permanent eye/ear impairment, bone fracture/dislocation, life-endangering injury)
Voluntarily caused without grave provocation
sections.max_punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

sections.description: Threatening another with injury to their person, reputation, or property to cause alarm or force them to do an act.
ingredients: Threatening another person with injury to person, reputation, or property (or person of interest)
Intent to cause alarm to that person, or to compel that person to do any act which they are not legally bound to do
sections.max_punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both (up to 7 years if threat to cause death/grievous hurt)

sections.description: Entering into or upon property in the possession of another with intent to commit an offence or intimidate/insult/annoy.
ingredients: Entry into or upon property in possession of another (or lawfully entering and unlawfully remaining)
Intent to commit an offence, or intimidate, insult, or annoy the person in possession
sections.max_punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 months or fine up to ₹5,000 (or up to 1 year for house-trespass)

sections.offence_title: Lurking house-trespass or house-breaking by night to commit offence
sections.offence_title_hi: रात में अपराध करने के लिए गुप्त गृह-अतिचार या सेंधमारी
sections.description: Commits lurking house-trespass or house-breaking after sunset and before sunrise to commit an offence punishable with imprisonment.
ingredients: House-trespass committed taking precautions to conceal it from person entitled to exclude
Committed between sunset and sunrise (night)
Committed with intention to commit an offence punishable with imprisonment
sections.max_punishment: Imprisonment up to 5 years (up to 14 years if the offence intended is theft) and fine

sections.offence_title: Assault or use of criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty
sections.offence_title_hi: महिला की लज्जा भंग करने के इरादे से हमला या आपराधिक बल का प्रयोग
sections.description: Assaults or uses criminal force to any woman, intending to outrage or knowing it to be likely that he will thereby outrage her modesty.
ingredients: Assault or use of criminal force upon a woman
Intention to outrage her modesty OR knowledge that modesty is likely to be outraged
sections.max_punishment: Imprisonment not less than 1 year which may extend to 5 years, and fine

sections.offence_title: Word, gesture or act intended to insult modesty of a woman
sections.offence_title_hi: महिला की लज्जा का अनादर करने के इरादे से शब्द, इशारा या कार्य
sections.description: Intending to insult the modesty of any woman, utters any word, makes any sound/gesture, or intrudes upon privacy.
ingredients: Intention to insult the modesty of a woman
Uttering words, making sounds/gestures, exhibiting objects, or intruding upon her privacy
sections.compoundable: Compoundable by the woman with court permission
sections.max_punishment: Simple imprisonment up to 3 years and fine

sections.description: When a criminal act is done by several persons in furtherance of the common intention of all, each person is liable as if done by him alone.
ingredients: Criminal act done by two or more persons
Done in furtherance of a shared/pre-arranged common intention of all participants
Active physical or coordinating participation in the crime
